Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bellevue for 2026, and here is what he found: 14 family events, 6 of them free. New in this update: Bellevue Downtown Ice Rink at Downtown Park (from November 13), Winterfest at Forum Social House (November 27) and Santa Photos at Bellevue Square (from November 27). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Bellevue families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

Planning Christmas Eve in Bellevue? See Christmas Eve service times in Bellevue.

What Rally found in Bellevue

  • 14 Christmas events for kids in Bellevue
  • 6 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Winterfest at Forum Social House (November 27), Santa Photos at Bellevue Square (from November 27) and Santa Saturdays in Old Bellevue (from December 5)
  • Also on the list: 1 show, 1 light display and 6 craft or cookie events
  • New events in this update run November 13 to January 18
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
